title: Fetch/report quests (Perrin's Mother wanting word of her son at Highward/Wardmoor; Two Keepers wanting word of Rowan in Thornwold's Understory) are handed out with no indication of how far those holds are from where the quest is offered - the true distance (dozens to 100+ turns) only becomes apparent from the Act 2 status paragraph's scale figures, not from the quest text itself.
where: Reedholm landing (Fenmarch) and the Keepers' Hall (Hollowbrook)
